Title: Some users’ email messages may not be quarantined and fail to be stored in the quarantine folder

User impact: Users’ email messages may not be quarantined and might fail to be stored in the quarantine folder.

More info: Some legitimate email messages are not being delivered to the intended recipient and cannot be released through the normal Microsoft Defender quarantine workflow.

Current status: We're reviewing support case details to determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: This issue may impact users attempting to have email messages quarantined in Exchange Online. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Next update by: Thursday, September 24, 2026, at 1:30 PM UTC

Title: Some users’ email messages may not be quarantined and fail to be stored in the quarantine folder

User impact: Users’ email messages may not be quarantined and might fail to be stored in the quarantine folder.

More info: Affected emails cannot be released through the standard Microsoft Defender quarantine workflow. The following error appears in message trace: '‎550 5.1.10 Failed to deliver to Quarantine store‎'.

Current status: A recent service-side update unintentionally introduced a code error that is causing legitimate email messages to be incorrectly quarantined and not delivered to recipients. We're developing a code fix and actively validating and testing the remediation in our test environment before broader deployment. We expect this validation work to be completed before our next scheduled communication update.

Scope of impact: This issue may impact users attempting to have email messages quarantined in Exchange Online. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Start time: Wednesday, September 23, 2026, at 12:56 AM UTC

Root cause: A recent service-side updated unintentionally introduced a code error that has caused this impacting event.

Next update by: Thursday, October 1, 2026, at 11:00 PM UTC
